> A second comment for https://github.com/gufo-org/gufo/issues/475, replying to the maintainer's answer of 8 Oct 2026. Not
> posted: the owner sends it. Everything below this note is meant to be pasted as written; every link in it is absolute and live.

Thanks. I want to be sure I set the right thing, because I can't match "repetition penalty is missing" to the preset table in https://github.com/gufo-org/gufo/issues/277.

For Flash-Next with thinking on, that table gives temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95, top-k 20, min-p 0, presence penalty 0 and repetition penalty 1.0. Our flags are the same except that we pass no penalty at all:

```
--think on --temperature 1.0 --top-p 0.95 --top-k 20 --min-p 0.0
```

A penalty we leave out should therefore default to the preset's 1.0, which is neutral. So I think you mean one of these, and I'd like to know which:

1. A repetition penalty above 1.0 raises speculative acceptance on Flash-Next. If so, what value, and is that expected or just something you saw?
2. Without a penalty passed explicitly, the server applies something other than the table's 1.0, so our run is not on the preset we think it is.
3. Something else about our setup that I haven't spotted.

Two smaller questions:

- Does a repetition penalty above 1.0 change the target distribution that verification preserves? That decides whether it is a setting we could compare fairly or a different workload.
- The question from my previous comment is still open: on the build before #282, did our CLI sampling flags apply to chat requests that omitted sampling fields?

We run the same flags for every run in a series, so we won't add a penalty to one build and not another. If a penalty is the intended way to run this model, we'd start a new series with it and report the two side by side.
